quickReviewNote: Open Items and inspect the proposed adjustments
homeIntro: See what changes before applying. Review the risks and take your time.
safeNote: Only verified adjustments with lower risk
balancedNote: Includes compatible power options and additional adjustments
aggressiveNote: More verified adjustments, without selecting high-risk items
customNote: Choose items and review each risk
cancelled: Analysis cancelled. No changes were made
complete: Analysis complete. No changes were made
idle: Run an analysis to inspect current values
safeDefaultNote: Analysis does not change registry, services, tasks or apps. Applying requires review and Windows authorization
metricsLater: Choose only features you do not use and review the risks of each item
autoRevert: Restore the original value from history
manualRevert: Reinstall through Microsoft Store. Original data and version are not recovered
appsIntro: Only installed catalog apps eligible for removal appear here. Each app needs your consent
scopeNote: Without administrator access, inventory covers only your user. Authorized removal affects all users and new profiles
noUndoDetail: App removal cannot be reversed by the journal. Reinstall opens the Store and does not recover data, original version or provisioning
noApps: No removable catalog apps were found in this analysis
reviewIntro: Review the risks and confirm to continue
ackNoUndo: I understand Undo does not reinstall this app or recover its data
ackRisk: I have read and accept this item's risk
ackUnverified: I reviewed the sources and accept this unverified item
ackAll: I reviewed this operation and authorize it
uac: Windows will request authorization. The helper exits when finished
executing: Waiting for authorization and operation completion
operationError: The operation could not be completed. Check history before trying again
emptyHistory: No applied settings in this history
protectedHistoryNote: Authorize reading to inspect the journal and removed apps. This does not change settings
recover: Some changes are incomplete. Review history and undo before applying again
privacyNote: No account, telemetry, update check or network calls. Only explicitly opening the Store leaves the app
advancedNote: Show technical state and unverified items for manual review
localPrefs: Language, theme and advanced mode are stored only on this device
notInstalled: Run an analysis to list apps
reviewRequired: Prepare a new review to continue
readError: Some targets could not be queried. Unknown state does not mean absence
analysis_busy: Wait for running queries to finish
uac_cancelled: Windows authorization cancelled. No operation was started
operation_failed: The operation could not be completed. Check history before retrying
identity_mismatch: The connection identity does not match this session
ui_must_not_elevate: Open the window from a regular terminal. The interface must not run as administrator
timeout: The response timed out. Check history before retrying
replay: This authorization has already been used. Prepare a new review
invalid_payload: The message was rejected for security
undoReview: Restore the original settings recorded in the journal
reinstallReview: Open the validated app page in Microsoft Store. You complete installation in the Store
historyReview: Read protected history without changing settings
catalog_mismatch: The application files have different versions. Use files from the same package
metricsPaused: Sampling paused. Values are from the last sample
metricNote: Samples every 2 s. App usage includes WebView2 and uses private resident RAM. No processes are terminated or have their working sets emptied
groupedMemory: Resident memory grouped by name. Shared pages may be counted more than once
metricsWaiting: Waiting for a real Windows sample
benchmarkIntro: Compare measurements under equivalent conditions. Allow at least 10 minutes of sampling, plus breaks and a reboot. This is not an FPS benchmark
benchmarkRules: Complete 5 runs of 60 s per condition. Discard the first as warmup. Only the remaining 4 enter the comparison
benchmarkInterrupted: The interrupted run was discarded. Completed runs were preserved
awaitApplyNote: Open Items and Review to apply. Only a confirmed helper response advances the protocol. Keep this experiment's power plan unchanged
awaitRebootNote: Reboot manually and reopen Ametista. Start the first After run soon after reboot, using the same plan. If you wait too long, reboot again to prove a new boot
condition_appsClosed: I closed unnecessary apps and tasks
condition_sameWorkload: I kept the same workload in both conditions
condition_cooled: I let the PC cool down and settle
condition_samePower: I kept the power plan, AC connection and battery state
readResults: Read the variation, not a promise
noiseExplanation: Each run produces a median. We report median, p5/p95 and median absolute deviation (MAD) across runs. Overlapping ranges or differences within dispersion and the resolution floor are inconclusive. This is not a significance test
temperatureNote: The app does not measure temperature or control cooling. You confirm that condition. Other workloads, drivers and Windows tasks affect results
persistenceNote: Completed runs are stored across reboots. Cancelled, suspended or interrupted runs do not count. The benchmark makes no Windows changes
confirmReset: I authorize discarding this experiment's measurements
noComparison: Complete 5 runs before and after to compare. The first of each condition is discarded
comparisonNote: Values describe this experiment. They do not establish causation, better performance or an FPS gain
runMediansCaption: Median and percentiles across 4 run medians per condition
presentmonExplanation: Install PresentMon yourself and select its executable. Import a v1 CSV (--v1_metrics) with one process and swap chain. Ametista does not run PresentMon, start ETW or open the game
presentmonDefinition: Average FPS = 1000 / mean interval between presents. 1% low = 1000 / mean of the slowest 1%. First row discarded. May differ from displayed frames. Not compared with system metrics
anonymizeNote: Removes all process and capture app names, their lists and boot identifiers. Personal paths are not collected. No remote report resources
exportDialogDone: If you confirmed a destination in the picker, the report was saved
metrics_unavailable: Metrics could not be collected. No values were estimated
metrics_layout: The snapshot layout is incompatible with this Windows version
benchmark_state: Wait for the current operation or check the experiment stage
benchmark_power: The power plan changed. Restore the original plan before measuring
benchmark_reboot: Reboot after applying and start the first After run soon after opening. If you waited too long after reboot, reboot again
benchmark_invalid_run: The run lacks valid 60 s coverage or was interrupted. Resume sampling and repeat
benchmark_storage: The experiment could not be saved or validated. Check local data and other open instances
presentmon_invalid: Select a PresentMon installation and a v1 CSV with at least 100 intervals from one process and swap chain
monitorExplanation: Keep the monitor in the tray while the interface is closed. It observes Windows events and uses profiles you authorized. Windows requests elevation for the session helper when applying
monitorRecovery: A session may need recovery. Start the monitor and authorize the helper to restore original settings before applying another profile
monitorConsent: I authorize starting the monitor and using enabled profiles. I understand Windows may request elevation and recovery after a failure may require authorization again
monitorNoAutostart: The monitor does not start with Windows. It does not close other apps. Stopping waits for restoration; failures remain recorded for recovery
gamesIntro: Choose the actual game executable and authorize only the temporary actions you want. The profile does not promise an FPS increase
stopBeforeEdit: Stop the monitor in Settings before editing the library
noGames: Add an executable to configure the first profile
monitorSettingsHint: The monitor keeps running when this window closes
temporaryRules: Apply on start and restore on exit. Services are only stopped, without changing startup mode. Actions shared between games remain until the last game closes
gameConsent: I authorize applying and reverting these actions during this game. I read the descriptions and understand that selected services will have their work temporarily interrupted
removeGameConsent: I authorize removing this registration. Game files will not be changed
chooseGame: Choose a registered game to review its actions
discoveryLimits: We read local configurations only. Steam, Battle.net and some Minecraft profiles do not identify the executable: use Add an .exe. Suggestions never enable a profile by themselves
gameDetectionExplanation: The monitor receives local WMI events at roughly 1 s intervals. It does not open game handles or read game memory. Without a readable path, it does not apply. Games already open before the monitor need reopening. Java games sharing the same javaw.exe cannot be distinguished
games_invalid: The registration or profile is invalid. Use a local .exe and only available temporary actions
games_storage: Game data could not be accessed or the monitor could not start. Check that ametista-monitor.exe is beside the interface
games_busy: The monitor is running. Stop it and wait for restoration before editing
monitor_event_error: Observation was interrupted. Check recovery, stop the monitor and start again
monitor_benchmark_conflict: Stop the monitor and wait for restoration before starting a benchmark run
monitor_items_skipped: Some profile items are unavailable on this PC and were skipped. Other items remain temporary
legacy_data: Previous-version data exists in ProgramData. Writing is blocked. Preserve the old folder; no data was moved or deleted.
effectsNote: Reduce transparency and motion when you prefer
ramShare: Available RAM as a share of total
cpuHistory: CPU over the last 60 s in this view
searchPlaceholder: Search for a setting or description
protection_unknown: Could not confirm whether it is enabled. Check the Windows tool before applying.
protection_disabled_by_policy: Protection is disabled by a Windows policy. Ask your administrator for help.
protectionWhy: A restore point helps recover Windows if something goes wrong. A verified point is required before applying.
diagnosticNote: The ZIP includes version, Windows edition, protection status, last analysis, journal summary and available logs. User names, paths and original values are excluded. Nothing is sent.
diagnosticUnavailable: Some data is unavailable. Protected logs and journal may require administrator access. Access protections are preserved.
diagnosticConsent: I reviewed the contents and want to save these diagnostics on this computer
diagnostic_storage: Could not save. Choose a new file name and an accessible folder.
diagnostic_preview_expired: The preview expired. Review diagnostics again before saving.
legacyGuide: Writes are blocked to preserve old data. Use the original version to undo in the VM and seek support before installing Ametista. Do not delete, move or rename the old ProgramData folder. Nothing is migrated automatically.
unsafe_installation: This folder allows replacing the helper before UAC. Use the installer in a protected folder. Portable mode is read-only here.
helper_integrity: The helper does not match this build or its signature is not trusted. Obtain the complete package from the official source.
supportNext: Next: check protection or review diagnostics before saving
noResults: No operation to show. Simulate a profile to begin.
onboardingDoes: Ametista explains Windows changes, measures the computer and records the original state before applying. Simulation changes nothing.
onboardingDoesNot: The app promises no FPS, never stops games and never changes Windows security. App removal requires separate consent: Undo does not reinstall apps.
onboardingReadOnly: Check protection in the Windows tool. You can continue to simulation. Nothing is enabled automatically.
onboardingProfile: Start with Safe. You can change profiles later and review every item before applying.
scanBackground: Analysis continues in the background. You can cancel.
rebootConfirmation: Some items need a restart. The button opens the Windows choice; nothing restarts automatically.
resultNext: Review changes and failures. To restore previous settings, review Undo. Removed apps need Microsoft Store.
nextSearch: Change your search or category to continue
nextTry: Check the details and try again
rowFailed: Could not complete this item. Review history before trying again.
gameSetupSteps:
1. Add a game
2. Choose actions and give consent
3. Read the consent and start the monitor
designOnly: Development reference. No action changes Windows.
privacyShort: The app sends nothing. Store opens only when you request it.
aggressiveCaution: Search and other features may change. Review each item before applying.
missingConsent: Confirm the required consent to continue
memoryHistory: Available RAM over the last 60 s in this view
sampleShortHistory: The chart starts with samples from this opening
rangeLegend: Line: p5 to p95 · Dot: median
exportPreviewNote: Anonymization removes process and app names and boot identifiers. Personal paths are not collected.
activeSessionNote: Authorized actions stay temporary until the last game closes.
appRemovedWarning: Undo does not reinstall. Store may need internet.
nowUnknown: Analyze to see the current value
safeGroupOnly: Selects only verified, reversible items without high risk
exportIdentityWarning: Without anonymization, the report may include usernames and paths. Review it before sharing
alphaNotice: Alpha · test in a virtual machine with a snapshot
